faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Everything one professional needs: the calendar, online booking, client records, deposits, reminders and your page on glowa. No commission and no contract. If you grow into a team, move to Studio.
faq.q2: What do I pay during early access?
faq.a2: Nothing. Every plan is free until {date}. Before any billing starts we'll tell you at least 30 days ahead, and you choose your plan yourself.
faq.q3: Do you take a share of revenue or of new clients?
faq.a3: No. The subscription is fixed. A client who finds you through glowa is yours — no commission, not even on the first visit.
faq.a4: A deposit goes straight to your Stripe account. Glowa adds no fee — you pay only Stripe's standard card fee.
faq.q5: What happens to my data if I leave?
faq.a5: It stays yours. Export your clients and bookings any time; closing your account doesn't hold your content back.
faq.a6: No. Booking through glowa is free for clients.
faq.a7: Yes, any time. The change applies from the next billing period.

calculator.subtitle: Put in your own numbers. We compare with the lowest published rates of a large marketplace platform.
calculator.newClients: New clients from the platform per month
calculator.assumptions: Assumptions: ~€17 a month for one professional or ~€12 per team seat, and 20% commission on a new client's first visit (minimum ~€5) — the lowest published rates as of September 2026, rounded in the competitor's favour. Excludes VAT and payment fees, which are similar everywhere.

forBusiness.metaDescription: Online booking, a team calendar, no-show deposits and a beautiful page for your salon.
forBusiness.title: The calendar that fills the chair.
forBusiness.subtitle: GLOWA brings online booking, a team calendar, deposits and a beautiful salon page together in one place. In Bulgarian, English and Romanian from day one.
forBusiness.heroAlt: A light-filled hair atelier with stylists and clients

depositPaid.title: Deposit paid
depositPaid.body: The appointment is confirmed and secured.

depositKept.title: No-show
depositKept.body: The deposit stays with the salon.

calendar.title: A calendar that works as hard as you do.
calendar.body: The whole team on one screen, live. Move an appointment with a finger, the system refuses double-bookings, and clients only ever book minutes that are genuinely free.
calendar.point2: Works by touch on the front-desk tablet
calendar.point3: Blocked time, breaks and a waitlist

deposits.title: The end of no-shows.
deposits.body: Take a small deposit on online bookings. If the client comes, it is deducted from the price. If they cancel in time, it is refunded automatically. If they do not come, it is yours.
deposits.point1: Money goes straight into your own Stripe account
deposits.point3: You choose which services, and how much

showcase.title: A shop window that sells for you.
showcase.body: Every salon gets a beautiful page with photos, services, team, reviews and opening hours. It is found on Google and looks good when you share it on Viber or Instagram.
showcase.point3: A QR code for the window and business cards

qr.title: QR codes
qr.body: For the window, the business card and the mirror, with a count of the bookings each one brings.

one.title: Create your salon
one.body: Name, address and opening hours. It takes two minutes.

two.title: Add services and team
two.body: Prices, durations and who does what. A deposit if you want one.

three.title: Share the link
three.body: Your salon page and a QR code for the window. Clients book themselves.

price.a: You can start for free today. Current plans are on the pricing page.

stripe.a: Only for deposits. The calendar, the salon page and reminders all work without it. The Stripe account is yours and the money goes straight to you.

phone.q: Does it work on a phone and a tablet?
phone.a: Yes. GLOWA installs as an app on your phone, and on the front-desk tablet appointments move with a finger.

clients.a: Your salon page with photos, services, prices, team and reviews, and booking in a minute with an email confirmation and reminder.

cta.title: Your next empty slot could be filled tonight.
cta.body: Create your salon in minutes. No contract, no credit card.

footer.about: Booking for beauty salons — clear prices, live availability and no phone calls.
footer.ctaBody: Calendar, deposits and online booking — no commission.

legal.signupNotice: By creating an account you accept the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and confirm you have read the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.

consent.title: Cookies, only the ones we need
consent.body: We use cookies to keep you signed in and remember your language. With your consent we also remember which QR code or referral brought you, so the salon gets the credit. No ads, no tracking.
consent.settingsBody: Choose what we remember. You can change it any time from the bottom of the page.
consent.necessaryBody: Sign-in, your language, the theme and this choice. The site does not work without them, so they are always on.
consent.attributionBody: Remembers for 30 days which QR code or link you came from, so the booking is credited to the right salon or friend.
consent.noTracking: We use no advertising or analytics cookies and share no data with ad networks.
